items: Recorder: Modern, client-side WebGPU canvas recorder. Powered by WebCodecs APIs (VideoEncoder, AudioEncoder, VideoFrame) and in-browser MP4/WebM muxing (mp4-muxer / webm-muxer). Captures canvas output directly in browser memory without requiring an external server.

Modern, client-side WebGPU canvas recorder. Powered by WebCodecs APIs (VideoEncoder, AudioEncoder, VideoFrame) and in-browser MP4/WebM muxing (mp4-muxer / webm-muxer). Captures canvas output directly in browser memory without requiring an external server.
